items.name: Finsupp.sum_finsetSum_comm
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_7} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N] {s : Finset β} (f : α →₀ M) (h : α → M → β → N) : (f.sum fun a m => ∑ b ∈ s, h a m b) = ∑ b ∈ s, f.sum fun a m => h a m b

items.name: Finsupp.sum_fintype
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Fintype α] (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N) (h : ∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 0) : f.sum g = ∑ i, g i (f i)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_nsmul

items.name: Finsupp.onFinset_sum
items.type: {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N] {s : Finset α} {f : α → M} {g : α → M → N} (hf : ∀ (a : α), f a ≠ 0 → a ∈ s) (hg : ∀ (a : α), g a 0 = 0) : (Finsupp.onFinset s f hf).sum g = ∑ a ∈ s, g a (f a)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_indicator_index

items.name: Finsupp.sum_onFinset

items.name: Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset
